name: Foreman Llothan

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals minor shock damage.

abilities.name: Extracted Poison
abilities.description: The boss throws a bottle of poison at the ground near a target dealing moderate poison damage over time as indicated by a red circle.

abilities.name: Explosive Diversion
abilities.description: The boss releases an explosion around himself dealing high shock damage and knocking players back as indicated by an expanding red circle, after which he then runs away. He only uses this when players are too close to him for too long. If you are fighting him at range, chances are he'll never use this attack.

abilities.name: Summon Scrib
abilities.description: Occasionally, the boss summons a small swarm of Kwama Scribs to attack the party. These should be killed quickly to simplify the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Llothan
dialogue.line: Cowards, the lot of you! This mine belongs to House Selos. You are intruders, and will be disciplined as such!
dialogue.trigger: After you clear the room of Kwama and Pit Rats, he will walk through the door.

summary: Foreman Llothan is a Dark Elf kwama miner found in Darkshade Caverns I, acting as the dungeon's first boss. He has a chance of dropping Llothan's Burning Crutch. He is clad in Dwemer Style light armor and robes, and his staff is in the same style.
